import os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                col=grid[r][c]; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and q not in seen and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==col:
                            seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
                comps.append((col,cells))
    top=min(r for _,cells in comps for r,c in cells)
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for col,cells in comps:
        dr=top-min(r for r,c in cells)
        for r,c in cells:
            out[r+dr][c]=col
    return out
'''
open('programs/task-30101243.py','w').write(code)
